deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026; the same deadline applies to all Biological Sciences programs.
deadline.quote: Applicants are responsible for ensuring that all materials are submitted by the December 1, 2026 deadline.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional; most Biological Sciences programs do not use them (Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics, Medical Physics and Public Health Sciences do consider them).

gre_subject.quote: GRE Subject scores are optional for all programs.

toefl_min.value: Biological Sciences sets section minimums only: on the new scale at least 5 in Reading and Writing, 5.5 in Listening and 4.5 in Speaking (100 total with sections of 26/26/26/22 before 21 January 2026).
toefl_min.quote: The minimum score (on/post-January 21,2026) for admission to the BSD is no less than 5 on Reading and Writing, no less than 5.5 on Listening, and no less than 4.5 Speaking

also.quote: 100 total, with no less than 26 on Reading, Writing, and Listening, and no less than 22 on Speaking

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 overall and at least 7 in each section.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum score for admission to the BSD is 7 overall with subscores of 7 each.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to seek advice from programs and faculty before applying; the application is to the program, not a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to seek information and advice from any of our programs or their faculty members.

funding.value: Funding (stipend, full tuition, health insurance) is guaranteed for the first five years, subject to satisfactory progress, and is available to international students.
funding.quote: Such assistance is guaranteed through the student's first five years of study, conditional on satisfactory degree progress

also.quote: International applicants are welcome. Our financial package is available to all students.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or equivalent degree is expected by the time you start; there is no master's requirement.
entry_route.quote: applicants to the University of Chicago's graduate and professional programs are expected to have completed a Bachelor of Arts (BA), Bachelor of Science (BS) or equivalent degree from an accredited college or university by the time they matriculate.

notes: Same Biological Sciences application, deadline and funding as the other BSD programs; this record covers the biomedical programs such as Immunology, Cancer Biology, Genetics, Genomics and Systems Biology, and Human Genetics.
name: Biological Sciences PhD programs (immunology, cancer biology, genetics, development, molecular metabolism)
